quick.title: EPC Quick Reference, version 10.17.24
quick.conflict_notes:
Guide v27 p32 has an MP example ending REPY, while its p33 naming examples and the newer Quick Reference use REPLY. Use REPLY; retain this discrepancy in the source register.
Quick Reference says to resubmit complete PLANS. Guide v27 p34 says files unaffected by correction comments should not be uploaded; revised files must be complete. Warn to send a complete revised PLANS set and complete SUPP if affected; verify an unaffected-file exception with intake. No automated submission or blocker.
Quick Reference (2024-10-17), p3, describes each PLANS page as bookmarked; CDD-0316 (2024-12-10), p1, explicitly calls for bookmarks for files with more than 20 pages, and section/document bookmarks elsewhere. Use the newer CDD-0316 minimum as the warning reference; bookmark/page coverage remains a manual Verify item. More extensive bookmarks may satisfy both; confirm the submission format with intake.
quick.notes: Retrieved official PDF; revision read from its printed footer.

316.title: CDD-0316 EPC Submittal Verification Checklist
316.conflict_notes:
EPC Guide v27 (2020), p11, recommends approximately 400 MB per PDF. CDD-0316 (2024-12-10) states APP 50 MB, PLANS 300 MB, SUPP 150 MB. Use the newer per-file limits as editable warning defaults; coordinate oversized plans with intake. REPLY has no verified size limit in CDD-0316. Prefer CDD-0316; never silently apply 400 MB or invent a REPLY limit.
Quick Reference (2024-10-17), p3, describes each PLANS page as bookmarked; CDD-0316 (2024-12-10), p1, explicitly calls for bookmarks for files with more than 20 pages, and section/document bookmarks elsewhere. Use the newer CDD-0316 minimum as the warning reference; bookmark/page coverage remains a manual Verify item. More extensive bookmarks may satisfy both; confirm the submission format with intake.
316.notes: Retrieved official PDF; revision read from its printed footer.
